name: native fail enums, setters, strings and fresh assignment
lua_assertions:
local function po(player, level, method, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(player, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, method, ...)
end
assert(po(0, 'Current', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_Immediate')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting', 'FailType_Off') == 'FailType_Immediate')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_Off')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'GetString'):find('FailOff'))
assert(not pcall(function() po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting', 'invalid') end))
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_Off')
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(.01)
assert(po(0, 'Current', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_Off')
assert(po(1, 'Current', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_Immediate')
po(0, 'Song', 'FromString', 'failendofsong')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_ImmediateContinue')
po(0, 'Song', 'FromString', 'failatend')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_EndOfSong')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'GetString'):find('FailAtEnd'))
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(.02)
assert(po(0, 'Current', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_EndOfSong')
assert(po(1, 'Song', 'FailSetting', 'FailType_ImmediateContinue') == 'FailType_Immediate')
po(0, 'Song', 'SetPlayerOptions', '')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_Immediate')
assert(po(1, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_ImmediateContinue')
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(.03)
assert(po(0, 'Current', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_Immediate')
assert(po(1, 'Current', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_ImmediateContinue')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting', 2) == 'FailType_Immediate')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_EndOfSong')
assert(not pcall(function() po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting', 2.5) end))
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_EndOfSong')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting', 'off') == 'FailType_EndOfSong')
assert(po(0, 'Song', 'FailSetting') == 'FailType_Off')
